scientific_integrity: Exhaustive 2048-mask induced-component enumeration; 195 elementary simplicial collapse pairs; complete acyclic face-poset matchings; independent mod-two boundary-rank calculations. The integral homotopy conclusions follow from the collapse and acyclic Morse certificates, not field-valued extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only the eleven-vertex Mycielski graph of a five-cycle; no general claim about other Mycielskians, no equivariant homotopy or all attaching maps between adjacent nonhomotopic stages. The ordinary first stage is already covered by earlier literature; literature indexing is not exhaustive.
title: A three-stage sphere plateau in the higher-independence filtration of the Grötzsch graph
